title: Sage sound record
description: A sound record (SoundRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another sound record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

variations+.description: Adds to "variations": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

variations-.description: Removes these from "variations" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

volume.description: Loudness before the bus and distance apply. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 1)

rolloff.description: How the sound fades from MinDistance to MaxDistance: linear, log (inverse distance) or custom (rolloffCurve) (Rolloff, default "Linear")

rolloffCurve.description: Custom rolloff: gains from 1 at MinDistance to 0 at MaxDistance, evenly spaced, e.g. [1, 0.6, 0.2, 0]. (List<float>)

rolloffCurve+.description: Adds to "rolloffCurve": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

rolloffCurve-.description: Removes these from "rolloffCurve" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

coneInner.description: Inner cone, full angle about the emitter's forward: full volume inside. 360 = omnidirectional. Unit: deg. Range: 0 to 360. (float, default 360)

coneOuter.description: Outer cone, full angle: OuterGain beyond it. Unit: deg. Range: 0 to 360. (float, default 360)

coneOuterGain.description: Gain outside the outer cone. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 0.25)

doppler.description: Doppler scale for this sound; 0 = never shifts. Range: 0 to 4. (float, default 1)

stream.description: Decode as it plays instead of whole: for music, ambience and dialogue. Ogg Vorbis (.ogg) only. (bool, default false)

caption.description: Subtitle or caption shown when it plays: text or @key; empty: none. Category: Accessibility. (string, default "")

speaker.description: Who says the caption, shown before it: text or @key; empty: a caption of the sound, not a line. Category: Accessibility. (string, default "")
